meta.subject: Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Science Standard Six Term I 2025
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive question framing: every distinct exam-worthy angle supported by the English/Tamil chapter is retained; no preset question cap. Derived classifications are included only when the chapter's own definitions support them.
meta.question_style: Natural competitive-exam wording; no routine 'according to the textbook' phrasing.
meta.quality_policy: Competitive-exam useful questions only. Classroom stories, activity props, learning-objective recall, ICT steps, picture trivia and conceptual duplicates removed.

questions.q_en: Which quantity is defined as part of this unit.
questions.q_ta: சரியான விடையைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்: இந்த அலகில் வரையறுக்கப்படும் அளவு எது.

questions.q_en: Which three quantities are computed in this unit.
questions.q_ta: சரியான விருப்பத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்: இந்த அலகில் கணக்கிடப்படும் மூன்று அளவுகள் எவை.

questions.q_en: Why does Babu say Mohan is moving?

The tree is in the bus
